absorb.title_zh: RM0008 Rev 21 中密度时钟、CFGR 与 CSS
absorb.title_en: RM0008 Rev 21 medium-density clocks, CFGR, and CSS
absorb.snapshot: RM0008 Rev 21, February 2021. Medium-density section 7.2 clocks, section 7.2.7 CSS, section 7.3.2 RCC_CFGR. Flash wait states are in the access-time text of chapter 3: 0 / 24 / 48 / 72 MHz in three steps. Timer times 2 is in section 7.2. Section 8.3.2 is the connectivity line and is void on STM32F103C8T6.
absorb.license: ST document terms (link and restated facts only; the manual is not redistributed)
absorb.do_not_copy: Do not paste section 7.3.2 or 7.2.7. Do not trace the official clock tree. Do not write connectivity-line OTGFSPRE or PLLMUL 000x reserved into the C8. Do not change the existing rm0008 object. Do not put 21 µs in chapter 02.
points: HSE 8 MHz, PLLXTPRE=0, PLLSRC=1, PLLMUL=0111 gives 8 x 9 = 72 MHz. SW=10 selects PLL. HCLK is 72 MHz. PPRE1=100 gives PCLK1 36 MHz. PCLK2 is 72 MHz
When the APB prescaler is not 1, timers on that bus clock at twice PCLK. TIM2-TIM7 are 72 MHz. TIM1 on APB2 with prescaler 1 is not doubled again
FLASH_ACR is at 0x40022000 offset 0x00. LATENCY is 2 for 48-72 MHz at 2.7-3.6 V. USBPRE=0 gives 48 MHz. ADCPRE=10 gives 12 MHz. ADCPRE=01 gives 18 MHz, past the 14 MHz ceiling

If HSE stops while it clocks SYSCLK directly or through the PLL, CSS switches SYSCLK to HSI and turns HSE off. If HSE was the PLL source, the PLL turns off too. The CSS interrupt is NMI. Write CSSC in RCC_CIR or NMI keeps returning. The same event also reaches the TIM1 and TIM8 break inputs
MCO=111 drives PLL divided by 2, 36 MHz, under the 50 MHz I/O limit. MCO=100 driving SYSCLK at 72 MHz crosses that limit. Section 8.3.2 is void on this part

absorb.title_zh: RM0008 Rev 21 ADC 转换时间、温度通道与校准
absorb.title_en: RM0008 Rev 21 ADC conversion time, temperature channel, and calibration
absorb.snapshot: RM0008 Rev 21, February 2021, chapter 11. Tconv equals the sampling time plus 12.5 cycles. The 1 µs example is 14 MHz and 1.5 cycles, an example at the ceiling. The temperature sensor's recommended sampling time is 17.1 µs on ADC1_IN16. VREFINT is ADC1_IN17. TSVREFE in ADC_CR2 enables both, and on a dual-ADC device that bit is only in ADC1. ADC2 channels 16 and 17 are tied to VSS. Section 11.4: ADON has been 1 for at least two ADC clocks before CAL is set. This snapshot does not include R_ADC or C_ADC.

Do not add picofarads or kilohms to this snapshot unless chapter 11 of this revision prints both R_ADC and C_ADC, and then use only the printed numbers.
points: At 12 MHz, 239.5 plus 12.5 is 252 cycles and 252 / 12e6 is 21 µs. 1.5 cycles is 125 ns
17.1 µs times 12 MHz is 205.2 cycles, so 239.5 cycles covers the temperature channel and 71.5 cycles (5.958 µs) does not. The channel is ADC1 input 16. VREFINT is ADC1 input 17
Set CAL only after ADON has been 1 for at least two ADC clocks. A 12-bit code uses 4096 steps. Code 2048 is half of full scale
